sections.heading: Glossary term: Astrophysics
sections.body: Astrophysics is a science that employs the principles of physics to study the nature of astronomical objects. In astrophysics, the radiation across the entire electromagnetic spectrum, together with non-electromagnetic signals, such as gravitational waves and neutrinos emitted by astronomical objects, are studied, alongside their properties in terms of brightness, density, and temperature. Astrophysics is a very broad science that includes branches of theoretical and observational physics.

sections.source_html:
Glossary term: Astrophysics

Description: Astrophysics is a science that employs the principles of physics to study the nature of astronomical objects. In astrophysics, the radiation across the entire electromagnetic spectrum, together with non-electromagnetic signals, such as gravitational waves and neutrinos emitted by astronomical objects, are studied, alongside their properties in terms of brightness, density, and temperature. Astrophysics is a very broad science that includes branches of theoretical and observational physics.

Related Terms:

  • Astronaut
  • Science
  • Gravitational Waves
  • Neutrino


See this term in other languages

Term and definition status: This term and its definition have been approved by a research astronomer and a teacher

The OAE Multilingual Glossary is a project of the IAU Office of Astronomy for Education (OAE) in collaboration with the IAU Office of Astronomy Outreach (OAO). The terms and definitions were chosen, written and reviewed by a collective effort from the OAE, the OAE Centers and Nodes, the OAE National Astronomy Education Coordinators (NAECs) and other volunteers. You can find a full list of credits here. All glossary terms and their definitions are released under a Creative Commons CC BY-4.0 license and should be credited to "IAU OAE".

If you notice a factual error in this glossary definition then please get in touch.
sections.body_ru: Астрофизика — это наука, использующая принципы физики для изучения природы астрономических объектов. В астрофизике изучается излучение во всем электромагнитном спектре вместе с неэлектромагнитными сигналами, такими как гравитационные волны и нейтрино, испускаемые астрономическими объектами, а также их свойства с точки зрения яркости, плотности и температуры. Астрофизика — очень широкая наука, включающая разделы теоретической и наблюдательной физики.

Related Media


Solar absorption lines

Caption: This is a high resolution spectrum of light from our Sun showing visible region of the electromagnetic spectrum. The absorption lines are visible clearly as narrow black regions. The visualization shown here was created to mimic a so-called echelle spectrum, with wavelength increasing from left to right along each strip, and from bottom to top. Each of the 50 horizontal strips covers 6 nanometers, for a complete spectrum across the visible range from 400 to 700 nanometers. This spectrum was created from a digital atlas observed with the Fourier Transform Spectrometer at the McMath-Pierce Solar Facility at the National Solar Observatory on Kitt Peak, near Tucson, Arizona (‘Solar Flux Atlas from 296 to 1300 nm" by Robert L. Kurucz, Ingemar Furenlid, James Brault, and Larry Testerman: National Solar Observatory Atlas No. 1, June 1984). Note: NSO/Kitt Peak FTS data used here were produced by NSF/NOAO.

media.caption_en:
This is a high resolution spectrum of light from our Sun showing visible region of the electromagnetic spectrum. The absorption lines are visible clearly as narrow black regions. The visualization shown here was created to mimic a so-called echelle spectrum, with wavelength increasing from left to right along each strip, and from bottom to top. Each of the 50 horizontal strips covers 6 nanometers, for a complete spectrum across the visible range from 400 to 700 nanometers.

This spectrum was created from a digital atlas observed with the Fourier Transform Spectrometer at the McMath-Pierce Solar Facility at the National Solar Observatory on Kitt Peak, near Tucson, Arizona (‘Solar Flux Atlas from 296 to 1300 nm" by Robert L. media.caption_ru:
Это спектр высокого разрешения света от нашего Солнца, показывающий видимую область электромагнитного спектра. Линии поглощения четко видны как узкие черные области. Показанная здесь визуализация была создана для имитации так называемого эшелле-спектра, где длина волны увеличивается слева направо вдоль каждой полосы и снизу вверх. Каждая из 50 горизонтальных полос охватывает 6 нанометров, что составляет полный спектр в видимом диапазоне от 400 до 700 нанометров.

Этот спектр был создан на основе цифрового атласа, полученного с помощью Фурье-спектрометра на Солнечной установке МакМат-Пирс Национальной солнечной обсерватории на Китт-Пик, недалеко от Тусона, Аризона («Solar Flux Atlas from 296 to 1300 nm» Роберта Л. Куруца, Ингемара Фуренлида, Джеймса Браулта и Ларри Тестермана: National Solar Observatory Atlas No. 1, июнь 1984 г.). 
Примечание: использованные здесь данные NSO/Kitt Peak FTS были получены NSF/NOAO.
